coverage.main: Read all 22 pages of arXiv 2207.05382v1 (12 July 2022; ECCV 2022): Sections 1-6, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-3, Figures 1-5, references and supplementary Sections A (proof), B (rho, sigma, N ablations, Figures 6-8), C (DCT/IDCT timing, Table 4) and D (visualizations).
coverage.supplement: The supplementary sections are appended in the arXiv PDF and were read. No separate ECCV supplement was retrieved.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box source cells in Table 1 and source curves in figures are excluded. Figures 1, 2 and 5 and supplement Section D are visualizations; Table 4 reports timing.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.2 and Table 1 (p. 10); Figures 3-4 (pp. 13-14); supplement Figures 6-8
result_groups.population: ImageNet-compatible NIPS 2017 dataset, 1,000 images; sources Inc-v3, Inc-v4, IncRes-v2, Res-152; six normally trained targets
result_groups.outcome: attack success rate (fraction of adversarial examples that 'successfully transfer'; not formally defined)
result_groups.evidence: No clean-correct filter or population rule for the success rate is stated. The released verify.py counts target misclassification over all adversarial images and divides by 1,000 (recorded as artifact evidence).

result_groups.population: Same 1,000 images; nine defenses (three ensemble-adversarially-trained models, HGD, R&P, NIPS-r3, JPEG, RS, NRP)
result_groups.evidence: Same undefined population rule; RS and R&P are stochastic predictors. The README's RS setting 'N=100, skip=100' would ordinarily subsample images, but published RS values have 0.1% resolution; correspondence unresolved.

result_groups.population: Same images; equal-weight ensemble of Inc-v3, Inc-v4, IncRes-v2, Res-152 as source; nine defenses

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy is reported for sources, targets or defenses.

f2.evidence: No target-clean-correct rule or explicit inclusion is stated for any group.

f3.evidence: 'Successfully transfer X% adversarial examples' does not state whether source-failed examples are in the denominator; the field-3 consistency rule leaves this unclear.

f4.evidence: One-decimal rates over the named 1,000-image set map to k/1,000 only if all images count, which the paper does not state; RS subsampling is unresolved and ablations are graphical.

f5.evidence: L-infinity throughout; 'in all experiments, the maximum perturbation epsilon = 16', T = 10, alpha = 1.6 (0-255 scale implied by alpha).

f6.locator: Abstract code link; artifact_checks below; survey/recomputation_ledger.csv
f6.evidence: The official PyTorch release tracks attack code, the 1,000 images with labels and verify.py, and instructs downloading third-party converted TensorFlow checkpoints (ylhz/tf_to_pytorch_model). The repository's historical record contains a fresh 1,000-image S2I-FGSM run with this release (Inc-v3 source, nine targets, per-example predictions in survey/recomputation/ssa_per_example_predictions.csv; per the recomputation ledger, e.g., Inc-v4 target 63.1% vs a published 65.0%). The repair audit has not re-verified checkpoint bytes, a run manifest or source-model identity for that run, so the historical record is not promoted to yes here. Highest-priority verification candidate.

artifact_checks.result: Cloned at the pinned commit used by the archived recomputation. Tracks attack.py, attack_methods.py, dct.py, loader.py, verify.py, torch_nets definitions, dataset/images.csv and 1,000 dataset images. verify.py sums argmax != label+1 over the adversarial set and divides by 1,000. Weights are not tracked; README points to github.com/ylhz/tf_to_pytorch_model and official RS/NRP repositories. Not executed in this review.

Historical archived run (repository-internal) with per-example predictions for nine targets; arithmetic verifiable with survey/recomputation/verify_predictions.py. No local populated SSA checkout remained to re-hash weights; a manifest with checkpoint hashes is still required.

bounds_checks.reason: The paper reports no clean accuracy on the 1,000 images; the historical archived run records clean predictions and could supply matched clean errors for its one configuration after manifest verification, but no published-population bound is inferred here.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. The archived SSA rerun is a historical record under repair review, not a validated replication.
No new execution in this review.
